# MANUS Archive README — WorldOS Phase 1 + Phase 2

## Purpose and scope

This archive contains **only Manus-produced** evidence and documentation from the authorized WorldOS Phase 1 and Phase 2 work. It is deliberately segregated from Main Agent, Marvis, Anonymous, or any third-party report. No new WorldOS browser investigation, cross-agent merge, product development, or E2E framework was performed while creating this archive.

> **Primary rule for later use:** Read the evidence-quality audit before merging any conclusion. A visible UI observation is scoped to the recorded identity, URL, action and time; it is not automatically a platform-wide fact, permission result, data-model statement or long-term SLA.

| Location | Contents | Most important use |
|---|---|---|

| `/home/ubuntu/page_texts/`, `/home/ubuntu/browser_html/`, `/home/ubuntu/console_outputs/` | Page-text captures, saved HTML and console output cited by selected source rows. | Secondary evidence for exact UI text, route content and tool limitations. |
| `/home/ubuntu/WORLDOS_P2_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE.zip` | Earlier Phase 2 package copy. | Convenience artifact; inspect live Markdown files first because the archive docs are newer. |

## Future main-agent merge order

A future main-agent merge should use the following process without treating this archive as an instruction to reopen WorldOS:

1. Read `MANUS_EVIDENCE_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, then apply its qualifier IDs to every candidate conclusion.
2. Take only the phase-level findings that remain supported by the linked primary report/timeline and its identity/URL/evidence row.
3. Preserve the classification vocabulary: `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_OBSERVED`, `BLOCKED — account gating`, `CREATOR_ENTRY_NOT_EXPOSED_IN_FREE_UI`, `VIEWPORT_SIMULATION_NOT_VERIFIED`, `DEVICE_BOUND_UNKNOWN`, `CLEANUP_BLOCKED`, and `UNCONFIRMED_CLEANUP`.
4. Use `MANUS_UNIFIED_ASSET_CLEANUP_MANIFEST.md` before discussing test-object removal or recommending any manual cleanup.
5. Treat P1/P2 locale, responsive and delete gaps as unresolved coverage—not negatives and not defects.
6. Do not merge any of these documents with reports outside this archive unless the receiving agent independently handles provenance and conflicts.

## Important archive boundaries

The Gift section confirms only a **visible 48-hour sender gate** and a UI-disclosed 70% statement; no real transfer or settlement was observed. App Direct/Market/Search results demonstrate a **sampled UI-surface divergence**, not a general indexing architecture or exact timing commitment. The P2 Map result describes a **free normal-UI creator entry not exposed**; it does not establish a paid gate. The responsive record documents a **validation-environment inability to reproduce required CSS viewports**, not a product pass/fail. Locale results cover named direct links and a query/hash sample only. `CLEANUP_BLOCKED` is intentionally not equated with deletion.

## Stop condition

This archive is complete as a documentation-only package. No further WorldOS browsing, destructive cleanup retry, new asset creation, cross-agent merge, or product follow-on is authorized by this README.
